bothSessionsStartFromTheSameFrozenSha: and from nothing else. Evidence produced against a different tree cannot be shown to describe the artifacts under review.

sourcePack.note: git-ignored; delivered out of band, never committed

must: hash the real official source bytes installed from the evidence pack
bind each sidecar to the frozen digests in pdf-implementation-freeze.json
raster official-source pages from the actual source PDFs
raster artifact pages from the frozen finalized PDFs
cover every page, not a sample
mustNot: lift a layer out of an artifact and use it as a source substitute

independence: Sessions 9 and 10 run independently from the same base. Neither may read the other's output, so two failures cannot agree with each other.

reviewer.condition: assigned only after both evidence commits exist. A reviewer may never review evidence it created, and there is nothing current to review until both land.
